brstu.title_block_policy: Use BrSTU/ESKD-style A1 frame and title block; apply GOST 19.701-90 as the binding flowchart-symbol standard.

terminator.meaning: External entry/exit of the scheme: start, end, external source or destination.

predefined_process.meaning: Process defined elsewhere as a subroutine/module/function block.
predefined_process.shape: rectangle with two vertical side lines

decision.meaning: Switching/decision function with one input and alternative labeled outputs.

data.expected_inputs: 0 or more depending on data source
data.expected_outputs: 0 or more depending on data destination

document.meaning: Human-readable document, log, report, request or approval artifact; in this drawing it is a terminal data output, not a processing step.
document.expected_outputs: 0; terminal human-readable artifact in this drawing

manual_input.expected_inputs: 0; manual data source such as keyboard/switch/button

manual_operation.meaning: Operation performed by a human operator.

display.meaning: Human-readable display output; in this drawing it is terminal visual output and does not drive a later process.
display.expected_outputs: 0; terminal visual output in this drawing

connector.meaning: Line continuation marker. Same-letter C connectors are a traceable continuation group: branch-end C markers symbolically continue to the C marker before End without drawing long crossing lines.
connector.expected_inputs: branch-end C: one or more incoming lines; End-before C: continuation target
connector.expected_outputs: branch-end C: zero drawn outputs; End-before C: one drawn output to End

branch_groups.notes: Start enters the Item Menu diamond. Item Menu drops to a horizontal distribution bus. Listed branch edges start on the bus and then run vertically downward into their top nodes. The final C is also a down-hanging connector reached from the bus by a vertical drop, not a circle placed on the bus endpoint.

layout_policy.notes: Start is centered and leads to the Item Menu diamond. Item Menu feeds a horizontal distribution bus. Exactly eight visual columns are centered around the menu with equal x spacing. Every vertical branch input/output segment is generated with one fixed boundary-to-boundary line length, and all branch-end C markers must land in the safe band above the title block.
